text:
GENERATE BURST N3-final-cam-01 — RE-MINT Matt's FINAL Necromancer master at the scene CAMERA, SCALE and GROUND LINE (Run C-6; Matt 2026-09-16: "re-prompt my current master necromancer to the appropriate zoom/angle and height % and scale"). task_id "N3-final-cam-01".

IMAGE 1 is the approved player character (the Keeper) at rest, facing the camera, on flat PURE GREEN #00ff00: a 512×512 canvas, the figure 240 px tall, feet on the ground line near y≈480, seen from the game's FIXED HIGH THREE-QUARTER camera (Diablo II / Last Epoch style — the camera looks DOWN at roughly 53°: the top of the head and the shoulders are seen from above, the feet are foreshortened on the ground plane, the ground is UNDER the figure). Its register is the register: tapered dark contours, flat painted planes, no gradient haze, no glow. IMAGE 2 is Matt's FINAL DESIGN of the character — the ONLY identity source: a tall gaunt necromancer with long straight bone-white hair, chalk-pale skin and cold eyes; a black cuirass with a bone-white ribcage relief over fine chain, ornate silver-edged pauldrons, a great curved bone horn rising from HIS LEFT shoulder (the viewer's right); a silver skull-and-bone belt buckle; a long split skirt of dark panels with silver trim; ridged steel greaves and pointed sabatons; a small dark leather tome hanging at HIS LEFT hip; and a bone-and-silver WAR SCYTHE held in BOTH gauntleted hands, the haft rising from low at his left hip past his right shoulder, the great crescent blade above and to the viewer's LEFT of his head — heavy black tapered line, ornate plates. IMAGE 2 is drawn from a lower, more frontal camera at a larger size — that is the ONLY thing wrong with it. IMAGE 3 is the size chart in the game camera (reference only).

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 2 and deliver ONE 512×512 image: the SAME man, the same armour, ornament, hair, tome, scythe (same size relative to his body, same grip, same blade position), palette and line, RE-DRAWN from IMAGE 1's camera — the same downward angle, the same foreshortening of the feet, the same ground line, the FIGURE 240 px tall from sabaton sole to the crown of the head (the scythe blade rises above that and must stay fully inside the canvas — nothing touches the canvas edge), standing facing the camera like IMAGE 1 (south), weight even. Flat #00ff00 everywhere else with a crisp edge; no shadow, no ground, no text. Keep every design element of IMAGE 2; change only camera, scale and canvas.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if the camera is still frontal/eye-level (feet seen from the side / no foreshortening), the figure is not ~240 px tall, the scythe or tome is missing or moved to the other side, the horn changed shoulder, anything touches the canvas edge, or the register softens — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/necro_final_cam.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "N3-final-cam-01"): files = [exactly one entry: out/necro_final_cam.png with its sha256]; images = the INTEGER COUNT of image_gen calls made (1 or 2) — NOT a list, and NEVER a path under $CODEX_HOME/generated_images; calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS with concerns listed honestly.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the Keeper at rest: camera, scale, ground line, register (reference only)
IMAGE 2 — Matt's FINAL design master to EDIT (first-party)
